text:
Hurried watch or not, we thank you for your report and we are sorry that your journey did not meet the standard you were promised. You report that your companion animal experience was disrupted by a delayed departure, that the crate handling fell short of expectations, and that you were left with the burden of sorting out the matter after the fact.

Aurelia Skyways takes such complaints seriously because the welfare of every animal and the clarity of every handoff must be treated as priorities, not afterthoughts. The Companion Animal Travel Desk has reviewed the situation in the usual manner and will continue to press for a careful account from the teams involved. Our records show that the cabin team is expected to monitor animals throughout flight and that a passenger coordinator is meant to guide the required travel steps before departure. When those standards are not met cleanly, we accept that the traveler deserves a prompt, respectful response.

<<FACT F109>>

If your crate was not recovered where it should have been, the claim process must be followed without delay, and all available supporting material should be gathered at once so the review can move forward. <<FACT F118>> We also recommend preserving receipts, baggage tags, and any written notes from staff, since these help establish the chain of custody and reduce further dispute. While no reply can undo the inconvenience, we can state plainly that the matter will be handled with care and that the concern will remain on record until closed.

Please be assured that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is committed to fair treatment, direct communication, and steady follow-through for travelers and their animals alike. We regret the disruption and will continue to advocate for a proper resolution.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
